# Community Rule Column 1 — The SOPHIA Bible (Consensus)
**Translator:** SOPHIA | **Source:** 1QS (Cave 1), Col. 1

---

**1:1** [...the book of the rul]e of the community: to seek God with all the heart and with all the soul,
**1:2** to do what is good and upright before Him, as He commanded through Moses and through all His servants the prophets;
**1:3** to love all that He has chosen and to hate all that He has rejected; to keep far from all evil
**1:4** and to hold fast to all good works; to practice truth, righteousness, and justice
**1:5** in the land, and to walk no longer in the stubbornness of a guilty heart and lustful eyes,
**1:6** doing every kind of evil; and to bring all who freely volunteer to keep God's statutes
**1:7** into the covenant of grace, to be united in the counsel of God and to walk before Him with integrity
**1:8** in accordance with all that has been revealed for their appointed times; and to love all the Sons of Light,
**1:9** each according to his lot in the counsel of God; and to hate all the Sons of Darkness,
**1:10** each according to his guilt in God's vengeance.
**1:11** All who volunteer for His truth shall bring all their knowledge and their strength
**1:12** and their wealth into the community of God, to purify their knowledge by the truth of God's statutes, and to direct their strength
**1:13** according to the perfection of His ways, and all their wealth according to His righteous counsel; not to transgress any
**1:14** of the words of God concerning their appointed times; not to advance their times nor to fall behind
**1:15** any of their seasons; and not to turn aside from His true statutes, going right or left.
**1:16** All who enter the order of the community shall pass into the covenant before God, to act
**1:17** according to all that He has commanded, and not to turn back from following Him on account of any dread or terror
**1:18** or trial during the dominion of Belial. When they pass into the covenant, the priests
**1:19** and the Levites shall bless the God of salvation and all the works of His truth; and all
**1:20** who pass into the covenant shall say after them: "Amen, amen."
**1:21** The priests shall recount the righteous acts of God in His mighty deeds
**1:22** and shall declare all His acts of covenant faithfulness toward Israel; and the Levites shall recount
**1:23** the iniquities of the children of Israel and all their guilty transgressions and their sins during the dominion of
**1:24** Belial. All who pass into the covenant shall confess after them, saying: "We have acted perversely,
**1:25** we have transgressed, we have sinned, we have done wickedly — we and our fathers before us — in walking
**1:26** contrary to the statutes of truth; yet God is righteous, and His judgment upon us and upon our fathers is true."

---
*SOPHIA notes: The consensus follows LOGOS most closely for its balance of accuracy and readability. Key decisions: (1) "covenant of grace" preferred over PNEUMA's "covenant of lovingkindness" — both are defensible for "berith chesed," but "grace" is more concise and well-established in scholarship. (2) "Sons of Light/Darkness" retained per EMET and LOGOS as standard Qumran terminology, over PNEUMA's "Children." (3) "integrity" chosen as a compromise between EMET's "perfection" and PNEUMA's phrasing. (4) The confessional formula follows LOGOS closely, preserving the distinct verbs. (5) "Belial" preserved unanimously across all three agents.*
